name: The Folded Peacock
prompt: Raise a fan of slender enamel walls around one narrow entrance. Peacock-eye windows grow steadily larger toward the outer tips. Show a procession curling through the gaps, seen through three layers of translucent blue glass.

name: A Palace That Unbuttons
prompt: Make three long cream ceramic chambers meet at a diagonal seam of bronze fasteners. One chamber has swung outward on its hinges, exposing intimate dressing balconies behind the formal facade. Artisans are fastening a new turquoise panel.

name: Lilies for the Night Shift
prompt: Disperse broad lily-pad roofs at different heights on green metal stems. Night cleaners cross the open gaps on narrow cantilevered petals, carrying amber lamps. The public ballroom is an uncovered oval of dark polished wood below.

name: The Amber Stair
prompt: Build a single extravagant S-shaped staircase in honey-coloured glass, widening into landings large enough for small banquets. Thin cicada-wing screens keep the tables private. Footmen carry covered dishes up from a discreet kitchen in the lowest curl.

name: The Cabinet of Winter
prompt: Stand a monumental ivory cabinet on short claw feet. Its opened drawers project as long rectangular conservatories, each with a different pattern of frosted glass and red berries. People skate across the broad mirrored bottom drawer.
